source_scope_changes_during_review.change: Only frozen oracle gradient accumulation indexing→iter_mut/enumerate; exact in-memory reversal recreates the initial SHA256. Arithmetic, reference, geometry, timestep/iterations and thresholds unchanged.

algebra.objective: Phi(q)=0.5*(q-z)^T M(q-z)/h^2 + 0.5*sum_r k_r C_r(q)^2; p=x-z, k=original area-scaled triangle stiffness.
algebra.linearization: Minimizing h^2 times the Gauss-Newton local objective gives (M+h^2 J^T K J)d= -M p-h^2 J^T K C. Woodbury gives (J W J^T+diag(1/(k h^2)))eta=J p-C, then d=-p+W J^T eta. Candidate signs and h scaling agree.
algebra.units: C dimensionless; J m^-1; k J; W kg^-1; A (kg*m^2)^-1; eta kg*m^2; d and p m. The Armijo objective/slope have units kg*m^2=h^2*J.
algebra.row_embedding: Pair rows i=0..5 select membrane i/3 and material axis i%3. Per-face gradients are embedded into the four union-node columns via validated unique local indices; absent node columns remain zero. Each face retains its own stiffness/grain/area.
algebra.mass_and_pins: Global physical lumped node mass is included once per union node inside a block. Pinned W=0 nodes start with p=0 and retain zero direction; no pin mass is duplicated as a free coordinate. Outer apply_pins preserves exact targets.
algebra.factor_and_search: Positive validated stiffness adds a positive diagonal to J W J^T. Scaled Cholesky refuses nonpositive/nonfinite pivots or nonfinite solutions before any mutation. Only a finite accepted Armijo trial writes x and p; exhausted search is unchanged. p retains actual rounded trial-minus-previous displacement.

caller_and_state_checks.partition: All shared edges are ordered deterministically by computed positive UV edge length bits, then ascending edge IDs. Greedy pairing uses only unassigned faces; partner symmetry and min-face group emission cover every triangle once, with singleton leftovers.
caller_and_state_checks.validated_pair_precondition: Triangles have distinct valid vertices and duplicate faces are rejected; >2 incident faces per edge refuses. Two distinct faces sharing the selected edge therefore have exactly four union vertices, satisfying the private pair-constructor expectations.
caller_and_state_checks.cache_lifetime: Group/union-node mapping is constructor-built from immutable ClothInput topology. Cloth fields remain private; new_cancellable publishes only a completed state; Clone includes the new field; reset restores positions/velocities with unchanged topology and needs no mapping rebuild. No new serialized/public/CLI/MCP input is introduced.
caller_and_state_checks.transaction: Correction histories are local vectors reset per substep. Step mutates candidate x/velocities/seam history only; cancellation, numerical failure and diagnostic failure return before final assignment to accepted fields. Material group cache is immutable during stepping.
caller_and_state_checks.cancellation: New edge candidates/partner iteration/group material solves poll the existing callback. The per-block kernel is bounded to at most six rows/four nodes and16 line-search trials. This preserves cooperative cancellation and core offset work propagation; no hard wall-latency claim.
caller_and_state_checks.other_algorithms: Bend construction/order, sewing loop, collision projection, pin application, velocity reconstruction, settings/material/defaults and validation/public boundary remain unchanged.
caller_and_state_checks.complexity: Construction adds O(E log E) ordering and O(T) mappings; each projection has a fixed3- or6-row solve. No nested all-face pairing search or data-dependent unbounded local iteration was added. The six-row factor can cost more than two three-row factors; docs disclose no speed/large-mesh benchmark.
